success.description: The flickering flames of all of your Bright Order spells rekindle and flare into a mighty inferno. You strike the target for 4+Int damage, +1 damage for each of your Bright Order spells (aside from this one) that is currently recharging.

bane.description: Suffer 1 wound per Bright Order spell you have currently recharging (aside from one).

sigmarsComet.description: Reveal critical wounds from the top of the wound deck until their total severity equals the number of Bright Order spells currently recharging. Discard the last such card revealed and apply the rest as critical wounds to the target.

conservative.requirements: 6 power. You must have at least one other Bright 3 Order spell recharging. If you are engaged with an enemy, add 1 {Dc} to your dice pool.
conservative.name: Inferno of Uzhul

success.description: The flickering flames of all of your Bright Order spells rekindle and flare into a mighty inferno. You strike the target for Int damage, +1 damage for each recharge token on each of your Bright Order spells (aside from this one).

sigmarsComet.description: Before resolving this spell, add 1 recharge token to each of your currently recharging Bright Order spells.
After resolving this spell, remove 1 recharge token from each of your currently recharging Bright Order spells.

reckless.requirements: 6 power. You must have at least one other Bright 3 Order spell recharging. If you are engaged with an enemy, add 1 {Dr} to your dice pool.
reckless.name: Inferno of Uzhul
